# Prompt Pattern: AI Analyze Requirements

Use this skill to assess requirement quality and testability.

## Template
Analyze requirement: <requirement-id-or-name>
Source: <path-or-content>
Business context: <feature objective>
Artifacts: <mockups/contracts/dependencies optional>

## Example
Analyze requirement: US-002 Create User
Source: requirements/US-002-create user.md
Business context: onboarding account creation flow
Artifacts: API contract v3, user-role matrix
